identification: Current Windows GPU name uniquely matched to the WebGPU adapter vendor
method: GPU timestamp samples at 60 Hz and ten AVBD iterations through 30 seconds of settling, using the demo's desktop storage limits. Contact overflow and solve-group conflicts are checked on every step. Physics-only runs compare sleeping off, whole-world waking and automatic connected-group sleeping. The worker view also draws at enhanced quality and measures falling and settled frames. Frame intervals are browser-dependent; GPU drawing and physics are recorded separately.
